kinds.d: Program that records the screen or camera, or streams it live.
Program that captures and annotates what is shown on the screen.

notes: Restraint-only. Screen recorder and streaming 30->14: market leaders and built-ins per brief, recording vs streaming as types, Fraps kept as icon of game capture; dropped e-learning authoring suites (Adobe Captivate, Presenter Video Express), Expression Encoder, Nero Vision, cloud clip tools and dead tails (Snapz Pro X, HyperCam, CamStudio, Screencam, Pixetell, Freeseer, recordMyDesktop). Snagit is listed under Screenshot tool only. Screenshot tool 48->14: Snip & Sketch merged into Snipping Tool, KSnapshot into Spectacle; dropped bug-reporting and team feedback tools (BugHerd, Marker.io, Usersnap, BetterBugs), mock-up beautifiers and minor tails. No new kinds.
